name: CLEAR-Continual_Learning_Benchmark
description: A dataset and benchmark suite for evaluating continual learning methods across streams of tasks, measuring how well models learn new tasks while retaining prior knowledge. It reports per-task and aggregated metrics (e.g., average accuracy and forgetting) to quantify forward/backward transfer and catastrophic forgetting. Designed to facilitate research comparisons on continual adaptation and memory-keeping strategies.
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face benchmark for continual learning research; modest adoption relative to major CL suites but useful for reproducible experiments.
